label: batch-48
tail:
Batch 48 authoring is complete: 11 A-page items and 3 B-page items are placed at dependency levels 0–6. The expanded PBW and Dong-locality proofs passed the final checks; I cross-checked the locality argument against [Arakawa and Moreau, Lemma 2.3](https://www.imo.universite-paris-saclay.fr/~anne.moreau/Arc_space-vertex_algebras-BOOK_version.pdf).

- **Checks passed:** 11/11 proof-bearing items passed precheck; proof layout passed for 14 items and 40 steps; author check and strict proof contracts passed; source coverage has 19 included results with 4/4 fetches verified.
- **Readiness:** all 14 Step 1 records are `ready` with current hashes. These are handoff records, not independent proof acceptance.
- **Run-wide blockers:** the global item-level check reports 121 errors, none for batch 48. The batch schedule check reports stale metadata: its 81 batch rows are unchanged, but the recorded and recomputed input hashes differ. The global cross-batch ledger also stops on an invalid `owner-escalation` status in batch 22. Batch 48’s own dependency graph and four cross-batch edges pass local checks; I left shared schedules and other batches untouched.

The batch notes record the inventory, prerequisite audit, source locators, check results, and blockers: [batch-48 notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-48.notes.md). The [batch manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-48.pages.json), [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/quantum-algebra-and-representation-theory/vertex-algebra-state-field-foundations.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/quantum-algebra-and-representation-theory/vertex-algebra-state-field-foundations-examples.md), and [cross-batch evidence](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-48.cross-batch-dependencies.json) are ready for review.
